notes.title: UPDATE 1.4.5 !
notes.content:
Changes:

[list]
[*] Added the ability to add a hotkey visibility toggle to any individual sprite.
[*] Added visibility toggle to the sprite list on the right
[*] Added the ability to remove/disable costume hotkeys
[*] Finally fully removed the buggy frame skipping so no more avatar exploding
[/list]

notes.title: UPDATE 1.4.2
notes.content:
[b]changes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixes for linux that could cause keyboard-like devices (like drawing tablets) to break window hotkeys
[*]Accidentally settings costume hotkeys to mouse 1 should happen less frequently now
[*]The avatar no longer reloads when pressing "R" while typing inside the file dialogue 
[/list]

notes.title: YUPDATE 1.4.1
notes.content:
Changelog:

[list]
[*] Fixed bug where default avatar wouldn't load in release versions.
[*] Fixed bug where window size wouldn't save.
[*] Added a notification for when costume is changed, so that accidentally settings the hotkey to mouse 1 is more obvious
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.4
notes.content:
Changes:

[list]
[*] New texture filtering toggle!
[*] Costume hotkeys now work when not focused in the window!
[*] Costume hotkeys can now be rebound to other keys!
[*] Bounce slider have been renamed to "bounce force" and moved into the settings.
[*] New bounce gravity slider in settings.
[*] New settings to control blink speed.
[*] Can now enable the bounce effect when switching costume.
[*] Png+ will now display messages after actions to make it clearer what's going on.
[*] Moved control tutorial to info popup, and added more commands to it.
[*] Removed buggy frame skipping.
[*] Fixed issue that would cause saving sprites from .save to fail. ( CONTROL + L )
[*] Fixed issue that would cause microphone buttons to go off screen if you had too many.
[*] Fixed issue where duplicating an animated sprite wouldn't pass over its animation values.
[*] Fixed issue where duplicating a sprite wouldn't pass over its costume layer values.
[*] Fixed issue where new users could have crashes when loading the default avatar for the first time. (hopefully)
[*] Fixed issue where mouse tooltip wouldn't scale correctly with the zoom.
[*] Fixed issue on mac because pngtuber plus wouldn't ask for microphone permission.
[*] Added workaround when on mac trackpad, up and down arrow keys can now be used in place of scrolling.
[*] Optimized sprite blinking and speaking visibility code.
[*] Optimized sprite WASD movement code.
[*] Optimized sprite selection shadows.
[*] Optimized the breast button.
[*] Other minor code maintenance stuff.
[/list]

notes.title: Hotfix 1.3.0.1
notes.content: fixed Issue that would cause program to not be visible inside OBS (my bad)

notes.title: Update v1.3
notes.content:
Changes:

[list]
[*] You can now clip mask linked sprites!
[*] New sprite list menu!
[*] New settings menu! (crazy right)
[*] Can now change the background color in the settings.
[*] Can now change the max fps in the settings.
[*] Mildly changed physics.
[*] Fixed slowdown when using altered fps.[*] Squash can now be made negative.
[*] Perchance fixed bug where sprites collision polygon would fail to build. Perchance.
[*] You can now no longer scroll select while moused over menus.
[*] Fixed issue where sprite would sometimes move when linking to other sprite.
[*] Fixed issue where sprites could disappear if trying to link a sprite to its own child sprite. This would also cause memory leaks, which has been fixed.
[*] Updated tutorial text to not be incorrect.
[*] Minor optimizations.
[*] Re-added the secret "breast button"
[/list]
